mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 63 degrees. The third quarter moon is out, and we expect an overnight low of 57 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is inviting residents to book free 30-minute rides on their tri-shaw bikes, which are pedal-assist vehicles designed for two riders to enjoy the scenery. Additionally, the recreation department is currently seeking energetic individuals for seasonal roles, including adult fitness instructors.

There is plenty to do in our community, including Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory today. Tomorrow, you can head over to Century School Park for the free Concerts in the Park series or participate in Hop Haus trivia.

Regarding the latest police report, an incident on July 31 involved an officer conducting a traffic stop that led to an arrest for an O W I, with the driver also cited for prohibited alcohol concentration and suspended vehicle registration.
Today's flavor of the day is the decadent Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The shop is currently closed, but they will reopen tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor will switch to Chocolate Caramel Twist.
